## Common WHERE Filters

所有查询均使用两个核心过滤条件：

```sql
-- 分区过滤（单日）
WHERE local_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
-- 或
WHERE local_date = date('${ISO_7DAY_AGO}')

-- 地区过滤
AND grass_region IN ('ID','TH','MY','VN','PH','SG','TW')  -- 标准 7 区
-- 或
AND grass_region IN ('BR')  -- 巴西单区
-- 或
AND grass_region IN ('PH','SG','TW')  -- L1/L2 区分组

-- 限定商品范围
AND item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM valid_items)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

本表作为维度表，通过 `LEFT JOIN` 关联到商品列表：

```sql
-- Pattern 1: 商品级 CSPU 类型查找（最常用，4/6 文件）
LEFT JOIN cspu_type_base b
ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
AND a.item_id = b.item_id
-- 部分场景加 grass_date 关联
AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date

-- Pattern 2: 用于 dashboard 聚合分析（2/6 文件）
cspu_type_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region,
        item_id,
        cspu_type
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_tc_ni_cspu_type
    WHERE local_date = date('${ISO_7DAY_AGO}')
    AND grass_region IN ('ID','TH','MY','VN','PH','SG','TW')
)
```

**JOIN 键**: `grass_region` + `item_id`（+ 可选 `local_date/grass_date`）

## Common Aggregations

本表为维度表，不做聚合。下游使用 `cspu_type` 作为分组维度：

```sql
-- CSPU 类型分布统计（dashboard 场景）
SELECT cspu_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM items_with_cspu_type
GROUP BY grass_region, group_label, pricing_type, cspu_type
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 商品特征宽表 CSPU 查询 (passrate 模型特征工程)

```sql
cspu_type_base as (
    select
        local_date as grass_date,
        grass_region,
        item_id,
        cspu_type,
        case when cspu_type in (1,4) then 1 else 0 end as is_p0_cspu_type
    from srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_tc_ni_cspu_type
    where grass_region in ('BR')
    and local_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
    and item_id in (select item_id from valid_items)
)
```

### Snippet 2: Dashboard CSPU metrics 查询

```sql
cspu_type_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region,
        item_id,
        cspu_type
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_tc_ni_cspu_type
    WHERE local_date = date('${ISO_7DAY_AGO}')
    AND grass_region IN ('ID','TH','MY','VN','PH','SG','TW')
)
```

### Snippet 3: LEFT JOIN with COALESCE (NULL 处理)

```sql
-- LEFT JOIN 后用 COALESCE 处理未匹配商品
SELECT
    a.*,
    COALESCE(b.cspu_type, -1) AS cspu_type,
    CASE WHEN b.cspu_type IN (1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_p0_cspu_type
FROM items_base a
LEFT JOIN cspu_type_base b
ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
AND a.item_id = b.item_id
```

### Snippet 4: Dashboard 综合查询（含 pricing_type 过滤）

```sql
cspu_type_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region,
        item_id,
        cspu_type
    FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_tc_ni_cspu_type
    WHERE local_date = date('${ISO_7DAY_AGO}')
    AND grass_region IN ('ID','TH','MY','VN','PH','SG','TW')
),
items_with_pricing AS (
    SELECT
        a.grass_region,
        a.reserve_criteria,
        b.pricing_type,
        a.cspu_type,
        a.is_p0_cspu_type
    FROM items_with_cspu_type a
    INNER JOIN performance_data b
    ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
    AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id
    AND a.item_id = b.item_id
)
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### is_p0_cspu_type (6/6 files)

```sql
-- 定义: cspu_type 为 1 (new cspu) 或 4 (not-enough / high demand low supply) 时为 P0
CASE WHEN cspu_type IN (1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_p0_cspu_type

-- NULL 安全版本
CASE WHEN b.cspu_type IN (1, 4) THEN 1
     WHEN b.cspu_type IS NULL THEN -1
     ELSE 0
END AS is_p0_cspu_type
```
